senses.gloss: f.(b. h. פְּעֻלָּה; פָּעַל)work; hire; wages; working stock (cattle, tools &c.). Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 10 כיון שבא … כביכול פ׳ לפניו when the Lord came to erect the Temple, it was, as it were, work to him (by ref. to Ex. XV, 17).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> (play on <he>פעלתי</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 26:5">I Chr. XXVI, 5</cite>) <he>על שפעל פ׳ גדולה בתורה</he> because he did a work which the Law considers great; <he>מה פ׳ גדולה פעל</he> what was the great work he did?—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41">Ex. R. s. 41</cite>; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 14 <he>נותן הזרע והפ׳</he> he (the tenant) furnishes the seed and the labor (working stock).
<cite ref="Tosefta Kiddushin 3:2">Tosef. Kidd. III, 2</cite> <he>בפ׳ שאעשה עימיך</he> in consideration of the work that I shall do for thee.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kiddushin 3:2">Ib.</cite> <he>על מנת שאעשה עימיך בפ׳</he> with the condition that I shall work for thee for wages.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 11:3">Midr. Till. to XI, 3</cite> <he>צדיק העולם מה פ׳ הניחו לך בעולמך</he> what work, O Righteous One of the world, have they (the wicked) left for thee in thy world? <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 11:3">Ib.</cite> <he>מה פ׳ פעלת לפועלי מצות</he> where is the reward thou hast wrought for the workers of good deeds? <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 44:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLIV</cite> <he>ראשונים … פעלת פ׳ גדולה</he> in olden times, in the days of Abraham, thou didst a great work (miracle); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 746:1">Yalk. ib. 746</cite>. Treat. Der. Er. Zuṭṭa, ch. II, v. <cite ref="Q00301"><he>פּוֹעַל</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:12">B. Mets. IX, 12</cite>, a. e. <he>יש בו משום לא תלין פְּעוּלַּת וכ׳</he> the law forbidding the withholding of wages over night (<cite ref="Leviticus 19:13">Lev. XIX, 13</cite>) applies to it.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 104">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 23</cite> <he>יצאו ישראל לקבל פְּעוּלָּתָן</he> Israel shall go forth to receive their reward; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּעוּלּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:2">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 11:18">Prov. XI, 18</cite>) <he>זה נמרוד שהיו פְּעוּלּוֹתָיו על שקר</he> this refers to Nimrod, whose works were in vain.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>כל פ׳ טובות ונחמות וכ׳</he> all the good rewards and comforts which the Lord will bestow upon Israel &c., v. <cite ref="Q01380"><he>פְּעִיָּיה</he></cite>; Tanḥ. Emor 11; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 314">Yalk. Is. 314</cite>; a. fr.
